description: x402 market report — the measured state of the x402 seller market: how many of the sellers in the 402index directory actually serve a valid 402 challenge, how many listed endpoints are dead, the grade distribution, the worst and cleanest sellers, plus which user agents and referers really reach an x402 endpoint (from this server's own hit log, our own checks excluded).
